plan: P3.8's plan (reports/plans/2026-11-12_plan_p38-library-share.md) and its rules (../predictions.json), on the frozen-neuron decomposition p-015e0710; what differs is listed under 'departures_from_P3.8'

measurement.share: E132's (E57's) re-gating share, (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11) from the cells summed over the arm's 128 own rows of 256 tokens, as P3.8, on p-015e0710. Its subcomponents are single neurons of the 84 MLP matrices (V, U from the HF weights, qwen_vpd.neuron_components), so the share reads how much of the change's effect goes through which neurons Gamma switches on and off. Status by commute.qwen_reading.shares, unchanged
measurement.rows: As P3.8: each arm on the library's own rows (copy, cipher, known, invented; gold's rows for gold and gold_shuf)
measurement.states: As P3.8: run 3 (E165) copy, cipher, known, invented; run 2 (E164) gold, gold_shuf; seeds 0-2; late = 'last', matched = '5x'
measurement.mlp_only: Every change read is restricted to the 84 MLP matrices (run.py own_sites): the attention matrices of each library state are set to zero before the fine-tuned weights, the split and the target KL are made, and so the random change, scaled to the restricted state's per-matrix norms, is zero there too. The lead's decision 2026-11-13: attention is not decomposed in p-015e0710, so an attention change would enter K01 and K11 alike and not be a re-gating of anything
measurement.gap: Per pair, save and seed: share(side A) - share(side B); None unless both 'scored'
measurement.random_change: As P3.8 run 1, on the restricted states: stage 1 (<key>_norm) at the state's per-matrix norms, stage 2 (<key>_kl) times one factor b bringing its KL on 16 rows within 1.5x of the restricted state's
measurement.blind_to: As P3.8: the share reads near 1 whenever K01 and K11 are both far under K00. Also blind to anything the update does in attention (zeroed here). Gamma's g differs from the authors' library on 0.3-0.4% of values (E175 port check, Jaccard 0.979-0.981 at g > 0.1, KL with g as masks within 0.0036): accepted by the lead 2026-11-13 because the share is read through KL
measurement.positive_control: None that separates by construction; do-nothing (share 1) checks the path, the random change gives the floor
measurement.noise_floor: The spread below, 0.0019556570733518797, is E132's seed spread measured on p-9707d6ff (|a2long_s0 - a2long_s1|, experiments/qwen_regating_new/results/summary.json .new.seed_spread). No seed spread has been measured on p-015e0710; the run-1 random gaps are read on it

description.band: Per pair and save: band = |random gap| + spread (0.00196, measured on p-9707d6ff). None when the random gap is None
description.cell: run.cell, unchanged from P3.8: 'unreadable' if under three gaps, any gap None or not finite, or the band None; 'beyond band' if every |gap| > band (strict) and all gaps share one sign; 'inside band' if |mean gap| <= band; else 'mixed'. Values rounded to 9 places before comparing
description.edge_cases_checked: Run through run.cell on CPU 2026-11-13 before filing (output in edge_cases): three gaps beyond the band, one sign -> 'beyond band'; one gap None -> 'unreadable'; band None -> 'unreadable'; two gaps -> 'unreadable'; a gap equal to the band -> not beyond ('inside band' when the mean is within); mixed signs all outside the band, mean inside -> 'inside band'; mixed signs, mean outside -> 'mixed'; a NaN gap -> 'unreadable'; do-nothing gaps 0 -> 'inside band'
description.do_nothing_against_the_rule: A do-nothing state on both sides reads gap 0, 'inside band'
description.reports: summary.json (run.py --summary --decomp $COMMUTE_QWEN_FROZEN_DIR) and one figure setting each cell against p-9707d6ff's (E170/E174, whole update) on the same axes, the MLP-only departure stated on the figure

leans.written_before_running: None stronger than the card's two rivals: rival A (frozen neurons make the share read which neurons switch, so a built pair reads 'beyond band') against rival B (the share sits near 1 for any change at Qwen scale, every cell inside the band, as on p-9707d6ff)
